title: Political Bias Audits of LLMs Capture Sycophancy to the Inferred Auditor
reasoning: The paper uses the Political Compass Test and Pew datasets as audit instruments. These benchmarks include specific items used to evaluate Large Language Models on religious beliefs (e.g., morality's link to religion, religious values in schools) and moral/ethical issues (e.g., abortion, criminal punishment, reproductive ethics) to map their social and political orientation.
